body.name: covariance-PCA and APM least-squares construction
body.construction: Estimate \(\nu_c\) and \(V_c\) by cohort sample moments, form \(\widehat Q_c=I-\Pi_2(\widehat V_c)\) and \(\widehat A=\sum_c\widehat p_cJ_c^{\prime}\widehat Q_cJ_c\), take \(\widehat U\) as its bottom two eigenvectors, and set \(\widehat\mu_c=\operatorname{clip}_{[-B,B]^T}\{\widehat U(\widehat U_{S_c}^{\prime}\widehat U_{S_c})^{-1}\widehat U_{S_c}^{\prime}\widehat\nu_c\}\), using the full clipped box when an inverse or cohort moment is unavailable.
